type Delta = Put string int | Push int | Skip
let replay script =
  let step acc op = acc
  let step acc op =
    match acc:
      case (puts, total):
        match op:
          case Put _ v: (puts + 1, total + v)
          case Push n: (puts, total + n)
          case Skip: acc
  List.fold step (0, 0) script

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [27, 39, 11, 29, 52, 13, 36, 25]
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l
print (minT tree)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf tree)
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt

let apply acc op =
  match acc:
    case (puts, total):
      match op:
        case Put _ v: (puts + 1, total + v)
        case Push n: (puts, total + n)
        case Skip: acc

let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars
let pretty e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({pretty a} + {pretty b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{pretty a}"
    case Var v: v
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

type Delta = Put string int | Push int | Noop
let runAll script =
  let apply acc op = acc
  let apply acc op =
    match acc:
      case (puts, total):
        match op:
          case Put _ v: (puts + 1, total + v)
          case Push n: (puts, total + n)
          case Noop: acc
  List.fold apply (0, 0) script

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast | Var string
let env = Map.ofList [("x", 4), ("y", -4)]
let evaluate e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evaluate a + evaluate b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evaluate a * evaluate b
    case Neg a: -(evaluate a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 env
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
    case Var v: v
let exprs = [(Num 3), (Mul (Num 4) (Mul (Add (Num 1) (Var "y")) (Num 4))), (Var "y")]
exprs |> List.map render |> List.iter print

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    return (k, n)
  }

let tally xs =
  let mut evens = 0
  let mut odds = 0
  let visit x =
    let bump isEven =
      if isEven then evens <- evens + x else odds <- odds + 1
    bump (x % 2 == 0)
  List.iter visit xs
  (evens, odds)

let running xs =
  let mut peak = 0
  let step acc x =
    let next = acc + x
    peak <- max peak next
    next
  let final = List.fold step 0 xs
  (final, peak)

  match t:

    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = [53, 54, 34, 13, 39, 5, 43, 55] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT root)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf root)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k root) [53, 56, 23])

let decodeLine line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }
